title: LedgerEntry
description: S11 Cortex evidentiary mirror row (contract-first): one hash-chained ledger entry per decision receipt. Mirrors the governed-spine chain rule: entryHash covers the governed fields (including actorId, receiptClass, and timestamp) plus prevHash, and prevHash uniquely chains entries (anti-fork). The seq-0 entry's prevHash MUST be the BioStack genesis constant sha256:genesis (SpineChain.GenesisPreviousHash). receiptRef is required and MUST be a URI: keon://receipt/{id} when Keon-anchored, or a distinct local unanchored scheme (never keon://, never a bare id). epochRef stays null until S11 epoch anchoring lands.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number within this tenant's chain. Genesis entry is seq 0 (SpineChain.GenesisSequenceNumber).

prevHash.description: Previous entry's entryHash in sha256:<hex> form. GENESIS: the seq-0 entry's prevHash MUST be the BioStack genesis constant sha256:genesis (SpineChain.GenesisPreviousHash); every later entry's prevHash MUST equal its predecessor's entryHash.

receiptRef.description: Anchored receipt reference (required). keon://receipt/{id} when Keon-anchored; a distinct local scheme such as marketops://unanchored-receipt/{id} for unanchored provenance rows (mirrors biostack://unanchored-receipt/).

correlationId.description: MarketOps correlation id threading this entry back to the gateway call and originating effect (PublishPacket.correlationId).

entryHash.description: Chain hash for this entry in sha256:<hex> form (mirrors the SpineChain.ComputeEntryHash / RuntimeReceiptFactory.HashSeed output shape), recomputed by the S11 verifier over the governed fields (including actorId, receiptClass, and timestamp) plus prevHash. Fixture values are illustrative placeholders, not verifier outputs.

epochRef.description: Cortex epoch anchor reference. Null until S11 epoch anchoring lands; verifiers must accept null, not treat it as a broken chain.

tenantId.description: Canonical tenant key. A ledger chain seals evidence for exactly one tenant; multi-tenant chains are forbidden.

receiptClass.description: Taxonomy class in family.subject.action form (mirrors SpineEntry.ReceiptClass, hashed into entryHash via SpineChain.ComputeEntryHash; legacy.unclassified is accepted for backfilled rows only, never issued by new code). MarketOps reserved-not-wired catalog (see KEON_RECEIPT_CLASS_CATALOG in src/lib/keon/types.ts): campaign.publish.*, approval.*, billing.*, browseahead.scan.*, ledger.entry.* — reserved pending S8-S13 wiring; fixtures may illustrate reserved classes but live code issues none until wired.

actorId.description: Who initiated the governed effect (user:{guid} or system:{component}). Mirrors ReceiptActor ActorId and SpineEntry.ActorId, hashed into entryHash via SpineChain.ComputeEntryHash.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the governed effect (ISO-8601). Mirrors DecisionReceipt.TimestampUtc and SpineEntry.TimestampUtc, hashed into entryHash via SpineChain.ComputeEntryHash.
